Prove: use an approved local capture or truthful designed-motion detail

direction.camera: Guide attention with layered interface; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: stack a small number of readable interface planes; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with frosted plane; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with clear control.
direction.lighting: soft edge glow; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: frosted glass and transparent acrylic; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around focus handoff; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use layered interface,frosted plane,soft depth,thin boundary,focus handoff,clear control as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
